about: The candidate ledger: one entry per idea, its pipeline step (docs/pipeline.json) and status. tools/gates.py writes the 'gates' field; the orchestrator writes the rest. Status: idea, testing, tester, demo, live, rejected.

candidates.name: USD/JPY London breakout
candidates.source: retail London-breakout concept, own test; research/london_breakout.py, research/breakout_ticks.py
candidates.ea: mql5/Experts/AurumBreakout/ (standalone), AurumFunded 1.03 and AurumHydra 1.33 off by default (InpBreakRiskPct)
candidates.summary: Range 01:00-09:00 server, each side once a day on a break 10:00-18:00, stop at the far side, flat at 18:00. Sharpe 1.18 to 2017 / 0.83 from 2018 at the measured 1.2 bp, 0.59 at 1.5 bp; |corr| with Hydra <= 0.03.
candidates.notes: The gates' own 2017-fitted weight (k=0.5 of Hydra's volatility) adds nothing from 2018 (3.37 -> 3.36): the leg was stronger to 2017 (1.18) than after (0.83), so the fit over-weights it. At AurumFunded's tested size (weight 1 = 0.125% risk) Hydra 3.37 -> 3.43. HANDOFF's 0.5% risk for Hydra (weight 4) gives about 3.46. The tester run decides whether it stays. Step 16 base: j3 legs off (AurumFunded 1.03, backtests/2026-10-17_0505_AurumFunded_funded_off) +167.7%, 6.67% eq DD, 17 day stops - matches the model once the 1.4 cushion cap of 1.01 is counted (research/funded_tester_gap.py). The legs-on run (both candidates) should give about +185-190% and 7.5-8% DD; well under the base's growth would count against the legs. Legs-on run (2026-10-17 07:10): +221.5% / 8.28%, step 16 passed in AurumFunded. j4 (AurumHydra 5x preset) was a set-up fault: 12 of 16 symbol inputs on another broker's names, one goal round at a 100 deposit; j5 reruns Hydra at size 1 from 10,000 on FTMO names (preset AurumHydra_FTMO_size1.set; model legs off +1184% / 10.7%, on +1574% / 11.5%, research/hydra_tester_expect.py). Step 17 (demo with the legs on) needs the owner: a3.

gates.note: seeded from a dry run (no trial logged: both legs are inside the 47 counted before the log)

tester.verdict: matches the Python figures; step 15 passed

step 16 passed in AurumFunded: legs off +167.68% / 6.67% -> on +221.48% / 8.28%, return per drawdown 25.1 -> 26.7, against an expected +185-190% / 7.5-8%; USDJPY +3,179 -> +4,671. Day stops 17 -> 21 (same two in 2024; the extra ones come at 2.5x+ equity, where the 3%-of-initial stop is ~1.2% of equity). AurumHydra's step 16 is j5 (j4 was a set-up fault).

candidates.name: Noise-area intraday momentum, S&P 500 and Nasdaq
candidates.source: Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon 2025 (read in full); research/noise_area_index.py
candidates.ea: mql5/Experts/AurumNoise/ (standalone), AurumFunded 1.03 and AurumHydra 1.33 off by default (InpNoiseMult)
candidates.summary: Bands of the average move from the 9:30 open, checked each half hour from 10:00 New York, trailing stop, flat at 16:00, 2% daily vol. Sharpe 0.88 at 0.75 bp (0.61 / 1.08), 0.57 at 1.5 bp; corr with Hydra -0.02.
candidates.notes: Weight fitted to 2017: 0.61 (EA uses 0.55, 0.275 per index). Hydra from 2018 3.37 -> 3.56. Step 16 base: j3 legs off +167.7%, 6.67% eq DD, 17 day stops - matches (see the breakout's note); legs on expected about +185-190%, 7.5-8% DD. Legs-on run: +221.5% / 8.28%, step 16 passed in AurumFunded; US500.cash -57 there, flat again - look at it once Hydra's j5 is in, without refitting weights on the tester window. j4 did not test the noise leg (SP500.r / NAS100.r not found); j5 does.
